title: Trump Says US Will 'Win' Iran War, Leaves Door Open to Further Strikes
detail: Trump told reporters the US will 'win' the Iran war soon and declined to rule out additional military strikes against Iran before the 2026 midterm elections, signaling continued military pressure.

title: Trump Administration Proposes $5B Fund to Rebuild Middle East Infrastructure
detail: The Trump administration proposed a $5 billion fund to rebuild critical infrastructure across the Middle East damaged during the seven-month US-Iran war, signaling a post-conflict reconstruction push.

title: Trump at UNGA: Iran Must Negotiate or Face 'Annihilation'
detail: Addressing the UN General Assembly, Trump issued a stark ultimatum to Iran — negotiate a deal or face total destruction of the Islamic Republic — framing the choice as diplomacy or annihilation.

title: Trump Claims 300% Inflation Is Economically Destroying Iran
detail: At the UN General Assembly, Trump cited 300% inflation in Iran as evidence that economic pressure is a key instrument of the conflict, arguing the Islamic Republic is being destroyed from within.
